Learner: Candidate. Partner: Recruiter.
Not in this scene: introductions, stating your name, saying which job you applied for, basic work history, salary negotiation, signing documents.

explain which experience fits the role — slot: the relevant experience
give a concrete example of a success — slot: the achievement
answer how you handled a problem at work — slot: the problem
ask whether a skill is important for the role — slot: the skill
ask what the team is like — slot: the aspect of the team
ask when they will make a decision — slot: none
must_understand: asks why you want this job
asks which past experience is most relevant
asks for an example of a success or a difficult situation
asks how you work with others or under pressure
says when they will contact candidates

phrases.pronunciation_native: puve vu mə parle də ___ dan lechip

partner_lines.text_target: Qu’est-ce qui vous attire dans ce poste ?
partner_lines.text_native: Ce vă atrage la acest post?

partner_lines.text_target: Quelle expérience passée correspond le mieux à ce poste ?
partner_lines.text_native: Ce experiență anterioară se potrivește cel mai bine acestui post?

partner_lines.text_target: Pouvez-vous me donner un exemple de réussite ?
partner_lines.text_native: Îmi puteți da un exemplu de reușită?

partner_lines.text_target: Comment travaillez-vous avec les autres sous pression ?
partner_lines.text_native: Cum lucrați cu ceilalți atunci când sunteți sub presiune?

partner_lines.text_target: Nous contacterons les candidats la semaine prochaine.

vocabulary.definition_target: to make something smaller or shorter
